heading: Definitions
lead: As used in this chapter, the term “judicial officer” means a United States district court judge or a United States magistrate judge.

notes.heading: Change of Name
notes.text: “United States magistrate judge” substituted for “United States magistrate” in text pursuant to section 321 of Pub. L. 101–650, set out as a note under section 631 of this title.
